title: Meta Page access token in an accounts response member
summary: A synthetic Page access token as the access_token member of an entry of the data array in the accounts response, pretty-printed, compact and with two Pages in one response.
rationale: Meta documents that a Page access token is returned in the accounts response in exchange for a user access token. The documentation states no prefix, alphabet or width, so the member name is the only identifying context and no bare-value rule is implied. The Page id, category, name and tasks beside it are not the token. The user token carrier is not assumed to equal this one, and the Page token is a separate family.

expectation.rationale: Project policy, maintainer-only (ADR 0020, credential-evidence#235). Finalized by the sole maintainer alone: not reviewed, not independent validation, queued for retro-review (#154). The question, options, strongest dissent and reversing evidence are in the review history. Flagged under project policy: the value of the access_token member of an accounts response entry is treated as a Page access token credential. Meta documents the response and its member (carrier existence only); the value admission and extent are the project's decisions.

sources.supports: This returns a list of Pages you have a role on, including the Page category, your permissions on each Page, and the Page access token.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed.
